title_en: The Stance of Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers on the Hadith of Al-Atit (Part 1)
description_en: The stance of Ibn Taymiyya and his followers on the hadith of al-atit, Part 1. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Part one exploring how Ibn Taymiyya and his school approach the hadith of al-atit.
